title: A test can reach a live model only when it asks for one
request: The owner approved decision D3 of the harness decision report: tests can never reach a live model unless a test asks for one, whatever entry point started them.
spec: reports/DCLab harness decision.pdf, decision D3; the guard sits where a real provider client is created, not in each entry point.
plan: find every place a real model client is created
refuse it inside a test unless the test opts in
mark test processes so background threads are covered

decisions.decision: Guard the creation of the real SDK client in AnthropicClient and ChatClient
decisions.why: every route to a model (the gateway, the twin lane, scripts) builds one of these two; an environment switch set by each entry point failed four times

decisions.decision: A process is a test when the runner marks it, when started as python -m unittest or under pytest, or when a test case is on the stack
decisions.why: the 2026-10-21 leak happened in an API worker thread, where no test frame is on the stack

decisions.decision: An injected fake client is never touched; a test opts in with DCLAB_ALLOW_LIVE_MODELS_IN_TESTS=1
decisions.why: many tests inject scripted clients; a few may need a fake local server on purpose

change: dclab_rnd/models/live_guard.py (new); dclab_rnd/models/anthropic_client.py and client.py call it before creating a real client; tests/run_parallel.py marks every test process (DCLAB_TEST_RUN) and drops any inherited opt-in; tests/test_live_guard.py (new).

findings.defect: live model keys reached tests four times
findings.scenario: a gate without the switch let the owner's OpenAI key plan an intern turn
findings.cause: the only stop was an environment switch each entry point had to set
findings.fix: a guard at real client creation
findings.impact: spend on the owner's key; flaky tests
alternatives: set the switch in more entry points (the pattern that failed)

findings.defect: a background worker thread has no test frame on its stack
findings.scenario: the API's intern turn in a test
findings.fix: the runner's process mark and the start command count too
findings.impact: the guard would miss the very case that leaked

measurements.name: the guard's tests and the files around the model clients
measurements.gate: every test passes with the guard on
measurements.result: all passed in the 13 files around the model clients
limits: the full gate waits for the nightly run (owner's rule)

outcome: A test process cannot create a real model client unless the test asks for one.
lessons: Guard the one place every path passes, not every entry point.
risks: a test that relied on reaching a local model now fails loudly and must opt in
